clues: A small town in Utah in the west of the United States. It sits a short drive to the southeast of Salt Lake.
In summer, folks from the hot valley towns below come up here to cool off. This town sits much higher up, so its summer days stay cooler than theirs.
When the mines shut down, this town shrank for a while. Then in the 1980s and 1990s it grew back as its visitor trade grew fast.
In 2015, two big ski resorts here joined into one huge ski area. It was the largest ski area in the whole United States.
This town was the first home of the Sundance Film Festival. That fest is the largest of its kind in the United States.
